prior: Resolution-specific zero-centered Gaussian scale mixture fitted by ash to multiscale parameters.

name: Poisson multiscale model with ash shrinkage
model_likelihood: Independent Poisson observations factor into total-count Poisson likelihood and binomial split likelihoods.
prior: Resolution-specific ash prior on log-odds split parameters; shrinkage toward zero corresponds to split probabilities near one half.
inference_algorithm: Approximate log-odds likelihoods as normal; apply ash; reconstruct using posterior log-odds means or delta-method moments; average circular shifts.
estimand: Poisson intensity function and approximate posterior variances and intervals.
data_input: Ordered Poisson counts summarized as recursive block totals, with log-odds estimates and standard errors.
tunable_settings: Fixed ash scale grid; reconstruction by plug-in log odds or delta method.
